[h3]To unlock purchased DLC:[/h3]
Main menu -> [Shop] button -> Selected purchased DLC -> [Already Purchased?] button -> [Activate With Honor] button

- Vegas mode now respect "Confirm Retry/Next Game" toggle

[h2]Klondike Vegas[/h2]

This update is to split Klondike and Klondike Vegas into two different modes. Previously if you wanted to keep a Vegas streak going you were locked into that mode and could not swap between normal Klondike and Klondike Vegas. 

[list]
[*] Klondike Vegas has its own mode now
[*] When playing Klondike Vegas clicking “Next Game” will instantly end the hand and open the end of level screen
[*] Klondike Vegas has a “Cash Out” option upon ending a hand
[*] Fresh Score option always will Cash Out on hand completion
[*] Only positive dollar amounts will be Cash’d out
[*] There is now a Bank to keep track of the amount you’ve cashed out
[*] On cumulative scoring mode the amount will no longer go below the default -$52
[/list]

Related to the Bank and the funds saved there, there is nothing you can use them for at the moment and will be just a way to save the money you’ve earned in game.

We might add things to spend the money on in the future but as of now it’s just for bragging rights.

[h3]What about current Klondike normal Vegas games?[/h3]
It will automatically be set as the active Klondike Vegas game

notes.title: Big Klondike 1.6.0 - Vegas Mode, Steam Achievements, + Thank the Devs Extras
notes.notes:
Big Klondike has been updated to version 1.6.0 this version includes:
[list]
[*]Vegas scoring mode - Begin with $-52 and earn $5 for each card added to the foundations. Much more challenging than the normal game mode.
[*]Steam achievements - 20 in game and on Steam achievements to unlock.
[*]Thank the Devs extra cardbacks - 2 new card backs have been added to the thank the devs DLC.
[/list]

[b]Please post a review for Big Klondike on Steam! [/b]

We have more fun ideas for future BK updates. Stay tuned!
This build hopefully fixes an outstanding bug that appeared to those who played many games. Thank you to those who submitted bug reports. Please let us know if there are any more issues.
This build enables opt-in error reporting for Big Klondike. If the game seems to have any errors please make sure you have enabled game analytics for automatic script error reporting.
